finding.title: GO reference links to a nonresolving ontology download URL
finding.description: The GO:0046943 reference at data/pathways/gallate-degradation-i.yaml:2800 uses http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/go/releases/2026-07-26/extensions/go-plus.ofn. Independent GET requests follow its 302 redirect to https://release.geneontology.org/2026-07-26/ontology/extensions/go-plus.ofn and receive 404 NoSuchKey; the HTTPS PURL and direct final URL also fail. The official QuickGO term page and API resolve and identify the exact nonobsolete term. The current SQL hash and version declaration are independently preserved, so the defect is public reference navigation, not an invalid ontology identity. Do not treat an embedded version IRI as proof of a downloadable original.
finding.normalization_reason: The source identity and pinned SQL evidence are retained, but the public reference hyperlink fails. This bounded provenance/navigation defect does not change graph semantics.

finding.title: Attach primary preparation evidence to seven construct-qualified edges
finding.description: native-022, native-026 and native-037 describe exact 2005/2011 plasmids, hosts and preparations, but their endpoint qualifiers cite only generic native heterologous-host evidence codes. Those codes establish an evidence class, not the exact stated preparation. Four desb-2005-* qualifiers also say Table 1 identifies BL21(DE3) as the expression host; the table supplies separate strain and plasmid rows, while the actual pETB-host expression assignment is in prose. Independent primary reading supports the biology, so this is a source-local provenance defect, not disproven catalysis. Attach exact short primary construct excerpts and precise preparation locators, and restrict structured assertions to actual table cells.

finding.normalization_reason: Exact primary facts are independently supportable and pathway identity/equations are unchanged; the defect is evidence placement and one overbroad table attribution.
